explanation: This test only partially covers the 'fx_lock' requirement by verifying the FX rate at initiation. It does not cover 'credit_before_debit' or 'dual_approval' at all. It lacks assertions verifying that the destination wallet is credited before the funding source is debited, or that top-ups above SGD 10,000 require second-owner approval. It also does not test rollback behavior on payment provider callback timeout. The test's oracle is superficial, only checking the FX rate display rather than transactional locking or ordering of operations.
missingAssertions: Verify destination wallet is credited before funding source is debited
Verify top-ups above SGD 10,000 require second-owner approval
Verify rollback occurs if payment provider callback times out
hypothesizedBugThisWouldMiss: A bug where the funding source is debited before the destination wallet is credited would not be caught, nor would a bug where top-ups above SGD 10,000 proceed without second-owner approval.

suggestedReplacement.description: Verify multi-currency wallet top-up transactional behavior including FX rate locking, credit-before-debit ordering, and dual approval for large amounts
steps: Initiate top-up of USD 100 and record FX rate at initiation
Verify FX rate used for conversion matches recorded rate
Verify destination wallet balance increases before funding source is debited
Verify system requests second business owner approval before settlement
Simulate payment provider callback timeout after 5 seconds on a top-up
Verify transaction is rolled back and neither wallet nor funding source is affected
suggestedReplacement.expectedResult: FX rate is locked at initiation; destination wallet is credited before funding source is debited; top-ups above SGD 10,000 require second-owner approval before settlement; transaction rolls back if payment provider callback times out
